title: Release version-pin sweep must include .windsurf/hooks.json, not only plugin/.mcp.json and server.json
observation: The cut-a-release runbook (rb_cut_release_01) and constraint con_d56f17a941 list plugin/.mcp.json and server.json as the exact-version pins to sweep after a package.json bump. The committed Windsurf hooks file also pins hunch-exact@npm:@davesheffer/hunch@<version> four times, and test/version.test.ts ('committed assistant hook pins match the release version') fails when it lags. During the 1.34.0 bump the sweep missed it; the focused test caught it before CI. The grep to confirm a clean sweep is: git grep -n 'hunch@<old-version>' -- . ':!CHANGELOG.md' ':!docs' ':!site' — must return nothing.
evidence: test/version.test.ts:41-47 reads ../.windsurf/hooks.json and asserts every hunch-exact pin equals HUNCH_VERSION
node --import tsx --test test/version.test.ts → '1.33.0' !== '1.34.0' after bumping package.json, server.json, plugin/.mcp.json only
fixed in 9020ada (chore(release): pin Windsurf hooks to 1.34.0)
